timeout_overhead_basis: smoke_v1 maximum measured outside-solve overhead 3.900 s; 30 s grace

baseline.description: Unmodified M2 from the preregistered pilot code

selection_rule: All original 30 small cases with the identical E6 baseline physical inputs and frozen M2 implementation; exact 300 s, one thread. Limited runs retain bounds and never become optimum references without a proof.
limitations: Synthetic appointments and costs; no market-price or population-significance claim.
Nested customer subsets share a source family and are not independent instances.
All planned first attempts remain in feasibility denominators.
